summary.revenue: Net sales for the quarter increased 9.1%, to $68.24 billion, from $62.53 billion last year. For the first 24 weeks, net sales increased 8.7%, to $134.22 billion, from $123.52 billion last year.
summary.eps: Net income for the quarter was $2,035 million, $4.58 per diluted share, compared to $1,788 million, $4.02 per diluted share, last year. For the first 24 weeks, net income was $4.04 billion, $9.08 per diluted share, compared to $3.59 billion, $8.06 per diluted share, last year.
summary.margin: Operating income for the quarter was $2,606 million compared to $2,316 million last year. For the first 24 weeks, operating income was $5,069 million compared to $4,512 million last year. No explicit margin percentages were provided.
